0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_GREETING_MARGRAT_000_000
0.description: To hear Thesauros's excuses, one might think it necessary to sell your firstborn to afford a comfortable chair and desk. Surely it isn't <hex:021A020203>impossible<hex:021A020103> to properly furnish a laboratory on a budget?

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_GREETING_MARGRAT_000_001
1.description: Hello, my fair gleaner! How goes the campaign of feline satisfaction?

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_GREETING_MARGRAT_000_002
2.description: Oh good, you're back. I think Ibuki is growing restless, so let's surround her with darling monstrosities before she launches a second assault upon Hodge.

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_GREETING_MARGRAT_000_003
3.description: A pleasure as always, my <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF046D616E03> of peerless procurement. Have you anything to soothe Grondilvet's tired eyes?

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_GREETING_MARGRAT_000_004
4.description: Another day, another battle of attrition against the enemies of ingenuity. Thrice-damned misers, the lot of them. But how do <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> fare, my friend?

43.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_TUTORIAL_000_000
43.description: Help Margrat achieve her goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with her and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

54.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_TUTORIAL_001_000
54.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Margrat's trust.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_TUTORIAL_001_001
55.description: With each successful delivery, Margrat will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Margrat's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about her.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_TUTORIAL_001_002
56.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Margrat needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your loquacious associate!

58.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_001_000
58.description: Sometimes a good cushion is all you need to transform any old chair into posterial paradise. I've even heard of designs that incorporate gelatinous material sourced from─well. So long as it's comfortable, right?

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_001_001
59.description: Treats and toys seem like promising candidates, but whether your devotion will be requited for long─if at all─depends on the kitty in question. Perhaps a wad of crinkly paper or a simple box will suffice?

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_001_002
60.description: It sounds like you're free to procure anything from grotesquely realistic clay sculptures to adorable plush creatures. Let it be known that I humbly request permission to squeeze should your donation be of the latter persuasion.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_001_003
61.description: Eye drops may seem like the obvious <hex:021A020203>solution<hex:021A020103>─ha! Get it?─but if you ask me, Grondilvet might benefit as much if not more from a fluffy bed or an eye mask. A quarter-bell nap can do wonders for one's health.

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_001_004
62.description: Any number of things can help facilitate relaxation─refreshing drinks, tasty snacks, mammet masseurs, you name it. All the more effective when prepared by <hex:022903EB0203> <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>self!

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_002_000
63.description: Stones with magnetic properties and herbal compresses are supposedly effective remedies for ailing backs, but do you know what's even better? Actual rest.

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_002_001
64.description: There is a plant which can induce a state of euphoria in felines, as I recall. Failing that, there's always the classic sandbox, which cats may utilize for their, er...daily constitutionals.

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_002_002
65.description: Let's give Ibuki whatever she needs to reverently whisper, “I've created a <hex:021A020203>monster<hex:021A020103>.” That's how we'll know we're on the right track.

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_002_003
66.description: Here's a clever trick for pain relief: warm some stones or poultices and then press them to your eyes. Or neck. Or back. Or anywhere, really...

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_002_004
67.description: Our refreshment room is supplied with water and tea, but what could spark more joy than knowing <hex:022903EB0203> has topped up our ice and replenished our leaves? Our beverages will never taste better, this I can assure you.

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_003_000
68.description: Back pain may be a symptom of a deficiency of nutrients essential for bone development. The positive effects of a balanced diet may not manifest immediately, but who doesn't <hex:021A020203>feel<hex:021A020103> better after a healthy meal?

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_003_001
69.description: Some cats can't eat fish, and most fish can't eat cats, but what can some cats eat that most fish can't? ...Catfish.

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_003_002
70.description: Certain shells are ground into powder for their pigments, and yet others make delightful decorations as they are. The right shade or sparkle can spur the spirit into a creative frenzy!

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_003_003
71.description: Blueback fish are apparently rich in nutrients that help prevent ocular exhaustion and dry eyes. Let's hope Grondilvet and his colleagues like seafood!

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_KNOWLEDGE_MARGRAT_003_004
72.description: After exhausting our daily cerebral capital, we often find ourselves gazing vacantly into the abyss...but think how less ominous it would be to gaze vacantly into an aquarium filled with colorful fish! Truly the height of luxury and far better for the soul.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_JUDGEMENT_MARGRAT_000_000
73.description: ...Yes, this should do nicely! A timely delivery of sufficient quality. Bravo!

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_JUDGEMENT_MARGRAT_000_001
74.description: ...Well, well! If I were a small animal, I might be inclined to run circles around you in delight. But I'm not, so I won't. Thank you, though!

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_JUDGEMENT_MARGRAT_000_002
75.description: ...Do you normally fling items of extraordinary quality to whomsoever is in need? Because such behavior may condition people to trail behind you like awestruck ducklings─myself included.

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_JUDGEMENT_MARGRAT_000_003
76.description: ...Even after all this time, your capacity for peerless quality is astounding. How could I <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> break into celebratory dance? ...Embarrassing? Perish the thought!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_FULLBAG_000_000
77.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_FULLBAG_000_001
78.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Margrat once more.

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_BEFRANKUP_MARGRAT_000_000
79.description: These should make all the difference! Wait here; I'll go and deliver them to my colleagues.

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_BEFRANKUP_MARGRAT_001_000
80.description: Cats have never struck me as particularly cheerful creatures, but even the most tenebrous tomcat will surely be moved to purr by all you've brought us. Give me a moment to present these gifts to Roaring Spring.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_BEFRANKUP_MARGRAT_002_000
81.description: Well, if Ibuki and her team aren't anything less than delighted, I think we may have to consider <hex:021A020203>them<hex:021A020103> monsters. I'll just be a moment.

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_BEFRANKUP_MARGRAT_003_000
82.description: Right then! I do believe we've accumulated sufficient succor for our blearily blinking comrade. I shall be back anon.

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_001
83.description: The results are in. Those items you procured for us...

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_002
84.description: ...are the best thing since sliced Archon loaf! Ahahahahaha!

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_003
85.description: No longer shall our backs suffer the cricks and cramps of outrageous furniture! With renewed health and mental clarity may we set upon our work and meet our deadlines without need for extensions!

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_005
87.description: Ahem. Theatrics aside, we are very grateful to you, kind <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF0473697203>. I'm afraid my complaints superseded a more civilized greeting, so allow me to properly introduce myself.

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_006
88.description: My name is Margrat, and I work as a specialist in propulsion engineering here in Sharlayan Hamlet.

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_007
89.description: Under the supervision of Kokkol Dankkol, my team participated in the development of not just the aetherburner, but the myriad ancillary propulsion systems of the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>.

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_008
90.description: As our assignment concerned the crux of the project, we worked in tandem with a variety of other laboratories.

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_009
91.description: My team was charged with performing analyses of the physical and aetherial phenomena to which the internal components would be subjected.

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_010
92.description: Another team calculated the necessary energy costs of all propulsion systems and proposed refinements to improve aetherial conductivity...

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_011
93.description: And yet <hex:021A020203>another<hex:021A020103> team drafted the plans that reconciled all our disparate findings into one cohesive image. Thus we spun our web of productivity.

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_012
94.description: Of course, a specialist is only as special as the demand for their expertise. So once the Final Days were thwarted and the threat to our lives no more, the threat to our <hex:021A020203>livelihoods<hex:021A020103> reared its ugly head.

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_013
95.description: Thankfully, our experience with the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> was of value to Garlond Ironworks, who offered my team the opportunity to collaborate on new airship engines. And so we live to labor another day!

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_014
96.description: True to their Garlean roots, they rely heavily on ceruleum to power their engines, but with a few adjustments raw aether can also─

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_015
97.description: ...Ah, but you know all about aether's potential, don't you! Tell me, why <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> you need those tanks?

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_016
98.description: It's not often─or ever, really─that people come clamoring for tanks with the capacity to power an interstellar vessel. Fancied a jaunt to the moon, did you? Ha ha!

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_017
99.description: ...You ripped a <hex:021A020203>hole<hex:021A020103> in the moon!? To forestall a voidsent invasion.

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_018
100.description: Ahahaha! Pull the other one, it's got bells on! Next you'll be claiming you're a Scion. Next stop, Ultima Thule!

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_019
101.description: ...Hm? Why are you giving me that look?

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_020
102.description: ...Wait. What did you say your name was?

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_021
103.description: <hex:022903EB0203>. Right. The very <hex:022903EB0203> who went to Ultima Thule with the other Scions.

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_022
104.description: ...Rhalgr smite you, Theopauldin. Would it have <hex:021A020203>killed<hex:021A020103> you to say something!?

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_023
105.description: All of us were...were so consumed by work back then that we never got so much of a glimpse of the Scions, let alone...

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_024
106.description: And now here I am whinging to you about <hex:021A020203>back pain<hex:021A020103>. What a laugh...

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_025
107.description: ...A-Apologies! I had no idea you were <hex:021A020203>the<hex:021A020103> <hex:022903EB0203>! It's, uh, quite a lot to process...

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_026
108.description: Thank you for taking the time to help us.

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_027
109.description: And, um...if you're so inclined, we would be terribly grateful for your continued assistance!

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_028
110.description: Thesauros is unlikely to loosen its purse strings any time soon, and we're still in dire need of things to improve our quality of life here in Labyrinthos.

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_029
111.description: What say you? I'll make you an honorary member of our team─or better yet, my own personal gleaner!

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_001_032
114.description: Compensation? Benefits? “Sod you, pay me,” as they say.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_033
115.description: An answer fit for a hero! Glad to have you with us.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_034
116.description: Spoken like a born freelancer! But to answer your questions, I could paper the city with the amount of scrips I have lying around. You have my word that we shan't leave you wanting.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_001
117.description: Our resident cat-lover insisted that he address you personally, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_002
118.description: I wanted to thank you for your many thoughtful donations. Their quality is astounding!

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_003
119.description: The lab cats have taken to them straightaway. Just seeing the joy writ plain upon their furry little faces has lifted the spirits of the whole team.

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_004
120.description: By the by, have you given any thought as to what sort of research Roaring Spring and his crew of cat-lovers might specialize in?

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_005
121.description: It may defy expectations, given what you've learned of them thus far, but any guesses?

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_006
122.description: Believe it or not, they are all experts in aero- and aetherdynamics─the studies of how air and aether move, respectively.

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_007
123.description: It is their comprehensive understanding of these mechanics which enabled them to devise not only the optimal form of our teeny-tiny toy boat, but that of its individual components as well.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_008
124.description: So while <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> were all losing our heads over the aetherburner, Roaring Spring and his colleagues were calmly ensuring that we had somewhere to stick the damnable thing.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_009
125.description: ...Which brings me to my question: why is your laboratory overrun with felines? Did the stress finally break you?

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_010
126.description: Not as such. Our kitties are the fluffy keystones of our latest intellectual challenge.

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_011
127.description: In the aftermath of the Final Days, we received a letter from an Eorzean naturalist named Marcette, who, er...<hex:021A020203>stridently<hex:021A020103> implored us to investigate a rather puzzling phenomenon.

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_012
128.description: The “spontaneous flight of traditionally flightless organisms.”

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_013
129.description: Shocking, yes. Imagine an adamantoise or dhalmel suddenly rising into the air and darting away!

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_014
130.description: But while such incidents may seem queer and inexplicable, we believe we can identify the root cause. Insofar as it relates to aviation, at least.

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_015
131.description: And once we know how these aerial feats were accomplished, we can assess which subjects may be manifesting latent abilities and which ones may be outliers of one sort or another.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_016
132.description: For her part, Marcette seems convinced that there are no outliers─that every subject was possessed of “ancestral levitational predisposition”─but regardless of the outcome, our research may revolutionize our understanding of aviation!

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_017
133.description: Indeed, even with my limited expertise, I can see the potential...

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_018
134.description: Naturally, our first step was to observe flight-gifted samples in captivity. And among those we collected, we found...<hex:021A020203>it<hex:021A020103>.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_020
136.description: Such grace! Such beauty! How could the air and aether <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> embrace you? How could the laws of nature not contort themselves to cradle your winsome curves!?

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_021
137.description: Yet a mystery it remains. A fabulous, fluffy mystery. One to which we will devote our waking days to unravel.

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_022
138.description: ...That's wonderful, Roaring Spring! I hope you all find fulfillment in both your pioneering research and your kitties' care.

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_023
139.description: Thank you, Margrat. I know we shall.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_024
140.description: And thank <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, my friend. We are fortunate to have been aided by such an accomplished gleaner.

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_025
141.description: Yes, well. “Gleaner” may have been the term I used to describe <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> for simplicity's sake, but truth be told, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> isn't of the guildship.

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_026
142.description: This is <hex:022903EB0203>. One of the Scions who went aboard the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>.

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_002_028
144.description: So I've been waxing poetic about kitty cats to...no, <hex:021A020203>commissioning<hex:021A020103> kitty goods from...

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_030
146.description: ...I'll, er. Go and check on him later.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_001
147.description: Look, I've procured something of my own! A researcher brimming with gratitude.

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_002
148.description: None of us were expecting anything remotely close to the quality of what you delivered. The whole team couldn't be happier.

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_003
149.description: <hex:021A020203>Finally<hex:021A020103> we'll have furnishings more inspiring than peeling wallpaper and criminally slow timepieces. I can feel my investment in the drudgery improving already!

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_004
150.description: So? What do you suppose Ibuki and her colleagues spend their time studying whilst their monstrous miniatures keep vigil?

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_A_003_006
152.description: Life sciences! I'd stake my life on it!

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_A_003_008
154.description: Have we confirmed they're not actually adventurers in disguise?

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_009
155.description: Oh, don't do that! While biologists were called in for the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>'s development, they didn't belong to Ibuki's cohort. Although I can see why you might assume so.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_011
157.description: Ahahaha! Skepticism well warranted, to be sure.

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_012
158.description: Ibuki's team specializes in materials engineering, so they were tasked with deciding what the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> should be made of.

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_013
159.description: As the mission was of the greatest import, candidate materials were subjected to rigorous testing to ensure safe and reliable operation.

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_014
160.description: For instance, every component within the engines had to withstand both the heat and stress the engine itself generated, as well as whatever bumps and scrapes it might suffer during the course of the ship's journey.

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_015
161.description: However, if the durable, heat-resistant materials they chose had been too heavy or difficult to work with, our starship would have been effectively the world's largest doorstop.

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_016
162.description: So to ensure the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> could actually fly and not be reduced to fondue in the process, Ibuki and her colleagues searched high and low for materials suited to each and every part. And on the occasion they failed to find what they needed, they rolled up their sleeves and created it themselves.

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_017
163.description: People tend to be more interested in the bigger picture─by <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103> is being made rather than what it's made <hex:021A020203>of<hex:021A020103>─but I've made my peace with it. It's a fairly mundane job, truth be told.

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_018
164.description: Not from where I'm standing! You and your lab are the heroes who help us realize our wildest dreams. We are forever in your debt.

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_019
165.description: Well, if you'd <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> like to repay the favor, you might try making a good faith effort to actually meet your deadline next time.

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_020
166.description: These days, we mostly deal in arms and armor production with external collaborators.

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_021
167.description: No matter how much you improve upon the previous model, adventurers always demand harder, better, faster, <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> stronger...

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_022
168.description: Which necessitates a more in-depth understanding of the circumstances which demand such performance. So we conduct simulations based on actual and theoretical experiences of veteran adventurers.

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_023
169.description: Which in turn means extensive research into the myriad monstrosities of the world! Perhaps <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> extensive, given how it has influenced our team.

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_025
171.description: Now whenever we see any reproduction of a monster, the potential battle begins...

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_026
172.description: Sharp claws! A lumbering blow! No, wait─<hex:021A020203>toxic, molten breath<hex:021A020103>! All powerless to penetrate our perfectly selected materials!

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_027
173.description: Then comes the counter─pikes piercing hardened scale! Blades carving through jets of viscous bile! Driving unimpeded towards their fleshy prize!

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_028
174.description: Aaah, I get shivers just thinking about it!

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_029
175.description: ...Considering your long and storied tenure, you may have worn or wielded something developed by Ibuki's team and not even known it!

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_030
176.description: Are guildship missions so perilous these days?

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_033
179.description: S-S-Signature! O-On the thing you just brought me, did you sign─!?

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_034
180.description: Just your initials on the underside!? No, <hex:021A020203>please<hex:021A020103>! Your full name, next time! Across the front!

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_035
181.description: N-N-Name! D-Did you sign your name on what you brought!? “Collected by <hex:022903EB0203>”!?

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_036
182.description: What do you mean you don't sign that sort of thing!? That's─well, no, that's fair. But...please sign <hex:021A020203>something<hex:021A020103> for me! Next time?

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_037
183.description: And <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, Margrat! How <hex:021A020203>dare<hex:021A020103> you conceal such crucial information!

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_003_038
184.description: Just wait till the rest of the team hears about this!

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_001
185.description: Look! Wouldn't you say Grondilvet's eyes glimmer with renewed vitality?

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_002
186.description: I sincerely doubt they <hex:021A020203>look<hex:021A020103> any different. But the efficacy of the items you provided is undeniable.

187.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_003
187.description: I've suffered fewer headaches, and my vision does seem clearer. I daresay this newfound comfort will enable me to execute my work with even greater precision.

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_004
188.description: You have been a boon to me and my team.

189.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_005
189.description: Out of curiosity, why so much intense squinting of late? It must be awfully delicate stuff to tax your eyesight so.

190.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_006
190.description: Indeed it is. Our current assignment is complicated─sometimes punishingly so─but we are resolved to see it through.

191.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_007
191.description: You see, during the ark's conversion to the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>, I spoke with Lominsan arcanists come to deliver supplies.

192.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_008
192.description: It wasn't long before we discovered, to our mutual delight, the uncanny similarities between arcanima and systems aetherology.

193.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_009
193.description: Arcane geometries were first conceived as a means to perceive and manipulate aetheric energy in specific natural environments─namely those of the south sea isles, the presumed birthplace of arcanima.

194.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_010
194.description: But while our regulators were designed to serve a rather different purpose, the underlying principles of their operation are more or less the same.

195.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_011
195.description: Now that we needn't concern ourselves with the end of civilization, we are free to engage in joint research with our friends in the Arcanists' Guild.

196.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_012
196.description: Sounds like our arrangement with Garlond Ironworks! What is your current objective?

197.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_013
197.description: We seek to incorporate analytical and conditional branching functionalities into a framework utilizing arcane geometries.

198.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_014
198.description: By iterating this process, we hope to produce a single, comprehensive system capable of a heretofore unrealized feat.

199.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_015
199.description: To wit, one capable of automatically heating foodstuffs to optimal temperature for consumption!

201.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_017
201.description: You mean, our days of eating cold Archon burgers would be over? Your arcane wotsit would be able to restore them to their original juicy glory!?

202.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_018
202.description: Mankind need never suffer cold burgers again.

203.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_019
203.description: Byregot has blessed you with His genius, Grondilvet! The world will never be the same after your aetheric food warmer is complete!

205.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_021
205.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Why is that name so familiar...

207.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_023
207.description: Er, about that. I should have mentioned sooner, but <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> is <hex:022903EB0203> of the Scions. One of the heroes who traveled aboard the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> to the end of the known universe.

208.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_024
208.description: ...Margrat. I expected more from you, of all people. To have let me in ignorance impose upon the goodwill of such an esteemed personage─

209.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_025
209.description: I understand how you feel, I do. But that's <hex:021A020203>why<hex:021A020103> I...I just...wanted everyone to get to know <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>.

210.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_026
210.description: Not as a hero on a pedestal whom we would never dare to approach, but as a person, like you and me. And I wanted <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to get to know everyone, too. The nameless faces that worked so hard to make <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> journey possible, and raised their voices in cheer at <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> triumphant return.

211.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_027
211.description: ...I suppose we <hex:021A020203>would<hex:021A020103> be glad for further donations, should <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> be willing and able to oblige us. My laboratory would of course contribute to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> due compensation, as well.

212.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_004_028
212.description: Until next time, then. ...And thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. For everything.

214.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_101
214.description: (-Reticent Researcher-)Erm, about that request I submitted earlier...have they reached a consensus?

215.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_001_102
215.description: ...All materials necessary for your current research have been allocated. Additional supplies will not be forthcoming.

217.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_104
217.description: Thus spoke the wise bureaucrats unto the obeisant workers. Tell us! What unreasonable desire did you dare voice to our overlords?

219.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_106
219.description: (-Reticent Researcher-)I didn't think it was <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> unreasonable, all things considered. What are we supposed to do now...?

220.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_107
220.description: Hmm... As good a chance as any...

221.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_108
221.description: I do believe we have your next commission!

222.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_109
222.description: The despondent man you see before you is Roaring Spring, a fellow researcher formerly assigned to the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> project─albeit on a different team.

223.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_110
223.description: I would be much obliged if you could procure whatever it was Thesauros refused him. He's a gentle soul, deserving of far better treatment than he's received, and I think you'll find his area of expertise fascinating─if you can guess what it is, that is! Well?

224.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_111
224.description: Rejoice, Roaring Spring! It just so happens that we have a special offer on all things Thesauros is too parsimonious to provide.

225.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_112
225.description: My great and benevolent gleaner friend will be happy to deliver your unreasonable desires.

226.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_113
226.description: L-Like I said, I don't think it's <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> unreasonable, it's just... Truly?

229.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_116
229.description: O-Or treats? Toys! Anything to amuse and delight our laboratory's kitty cats!

230.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_117
230.description: Their comfort is our comfort─their happiness, our happiness!

231.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_ROARINGSPRING_001_118
231.description: Anything in bulk would be greatly appreciated!

232.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_119
232.description: Ahahaha! Kitty cats!? Since when did you and your colleagues become so adorable?

233.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_120
233.description: ...A bit of a surprising request, but we can hardly fault him for his passion. See what you can come up with, and I'll be sure to pass it along!

234.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_100
234.description: (-???-)Oi, Hodge! I've come for my package. Where is it!?

235.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_002_101
235.description: ...The items you requested were deemed nonessential.

236.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_102
236.description: (-Raging Researcher-)“Nonessential,” eh? And is my willingness to toil away in those bland biscuit boxes you call laboratories nonessential? Is my <hex:021A020203>motivation<hex:021A020103> nonessential!? Is it!?

237.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_002_103
237.description: ...You are free to purchase whatever you like with personal funds.

240.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_106
240.description: Ibuki? While I understand your frustration, you cannot simply unleash your concentrated ire all at once to effect a change. Nay, we must use the paymasters' methods against their agents. As they slowly grind away at our spirits, so too must we wear down Hodge.

241.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_107
241.description: I'll bear that in mind, Margrat. And how's your deadline looking?

242.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_108
242.description: I'll deadline <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> if you ever lead with <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> again!

243.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_109
243.description: S-Sorry, sorry. Clearly you <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> understand my frustration. I presume, like me, you've been <hex:021A020203>trying<hex:021A020103> to improve your team's working conditions, but to no avail...

244.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_110
244.description: Precisely why I called you over. If Thesauros is giving you the cold shoulder, we may be able to help.

246.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_A_002_112
246.description: My neck and shoulder muscles are generally warm from prodigious use.

247.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_A_002_113
247.description: You don't think this is going to be another cat thing, do you?

248.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_114
248.description: The better for you to communicate your shared desire that none labor in misery! Huzzah!

249.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_115
249.description: Who knows? There's no end to delightful surprises here in Labyrinthos!

250.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_116
250.description: You're in good hands, comrade. As an extension of our special offer, let us provide you with the conveniences Thesauros won't.

251.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_117
251.description: My exclusive gleaner is happy to procure anything your heart desires. You need but ask!

252.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_118
252.description: I'm, er...not sure what's going on, but far be it from me to look a gift chocobo in the mouth!

253.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_119
253.description: We would like...monsters! Fiends, feral beasts, voidsent, primals─whatever you can provide. Miniatures, that is!

254.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_120
254.description: Any size, style, or shape. Wood carvings, life-sized cushions, soap sculptures. Honestly, <hex:021A020203>anything<hex:021A020103>.

255.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_121
255.description: If you need specific examples, one of the Ironworks engineers is a warmachina fanatic who crafts stunningly realistic replicas. Or you might reference the more simplistic mammets created by that infamous Gridanian goldsmith.

256.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_122
256.description: Even if you can only manage supplies, we would be more than delighted to make our own miniatures! ...Time permitting.

257.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_IBUKI_002_123
257.description: Right, well─now that I've thoroughly embarrassed myself, thank you in advance, kind stranger!

258.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_124
258.description: Ibuki was assigned to the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> project as well. Any guesses as to what her specialty is? Let me know when you think you've figured it out─and when your first monstrous donation is ready for delivery!

259.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_100
259.description: (-Rational Researcher-)Ibuki just ran by shrieking like a jilted chocobo. Is something amiss?

260.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_101
260.description: (-Rational Researcher-)...I suppose there's no telling with her. Never mind─ Hodge, I'm here to collect my supplies.

261.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_003_102
261.description: ...Your request was denied. You are encouraged to recuperate at home.

263.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_003_104
263.description: Rich or not, that is the official answer.

264.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_HODGE_003_105
264.description: ...But those two have a special offer for rejected petitioners.

265.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_106
265.description: Why, Hodge! The very nerve of you!

266.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_107
266.description: (-Rational Researcher-)Well met, Margrat. I'm glad to find you in high spirits and not your usual state of inconsolable weeping.

267.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_108
267.description: (-Rational Researcher-)I believe we have yet to be acquainted. Grondilvet, systems aetherologist.

268.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_109
268.description: No, no, no! Grondilvet, your good breeding ruined our fun little game! I've been challenging <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to guess who did what on the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>!

269.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_110
269.description: Our systems aetherologists basically ensured that, on an arcane level, the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> was easy to operate.

270.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_111
270.description: Each component was imbued with supplementary magick─and <hex:021A020203>without<hex:021A020103> having to employ overworked mages scurrying about activating geometries.

271.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_112
271.description: This was possible because many systems were designed to function automatically in the presence of sufficient aether. But how do you ensure the requisite quantities of aether are supplied throughout the ship?

272.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_113
272.description: Call in the systems aetherologists! Grondilvet's team was tasked with the development of regulators to reallocate aether as the systems dictate, so when our furry pilots engaged the throttle, the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> sped up instead of sputtering to a halt. Or exploding.

273.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_114
273.description: Needless to say, it is intricate work that requires a deep understanding of how a host of complex mechanisms interact. Far beyond the scope of a harried gaggle of mages.

274.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_115
274.description: Goodness. Your effulgent praise has my bosom all atingle.

275.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_116
275.description: But returning to what Hodge mentioned─you are fulfilling requests which Thesauros denies?

276.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_117
276.description: Why, we are indeed! My exclusive gleaner here is second to none when satisfying the needs of the needy. Take advantage of our free trial today!

277.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_118
277.description: Though I'm curious as to what prompted said trial, it would be foolish to reject your offer.

278.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_119
278.description: Very well. Might I commission some remedies for weary eyes?

279.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_120
279.description: Eye drops would suffice, as would items that improve circulation. Foodstuffs purported to improve visual acuity would be welcome, too.

280.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_121
280.description: If it may aid in the preservation or enhancement of eyesight, my team and I would welcome whatever you can provide.

281.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_122
281.description: Ahhh, I <hex:021A020203>see<hex:021A020103>! Been burning the midnight oil, have we? A man after my own heart.

282.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_123
282.description: Well then, my gleaning genius! Let's find this hard worker respite for his tired eyes, shall we?

283.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_000
283.description: Margrat is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Kind Collaborator<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

284.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_001
284.description: Margrat is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Facilitator of Feline Felicity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

285.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_002
285.description: Margrat is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gracious Gleaner<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

286.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_003
286.description: Margrat could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Irreplaceable Comrade<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

287.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_001_001
287.description: And yet, there is still much work to be done if the researchers of Sharlayan Hamlet are to have their myriad needs met. To that end, Margrat has a new favor to ask of you...

288.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_001_002
288.description: Through your efforts, many dedicated intellectuals have found comfort and respite. It seems, however, that Margrat has something on her mind...

289.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTRANKUP_000_001
289.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Margrat has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Margrat and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

290.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTRANKUP_001_001
290.description: A new quest continuing the story of Margrat's work in Sharlayan Hamlet is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Margrat will be updated.

291.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_000
291.description: ...Hm? Why have I not returned to my lab and my other neglected responsibilities?

292.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_001
292.description: Never you fear; I'll tend to the perpetual bin fires just as soon as you leave. ...You're in no hurry to go, right?

293.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_000
293.description: I respect your dedication, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Hand-delivering commissions on time and with a smile...now that's service.

294.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_001
294.description: Despite what others may whisper (and occasionally declare loudly within earshot), I too strive for punctuality! And were it not for the bastar─er, <hex:021A020203>management<hex:021A020103> stipulating such...<hex:021A020203>aggressive<hex:021A020103> deadlines, I might well have time for a smile or two!

295.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_000
295.description: Excellent, this should do us quite nicely. ...I take it you'll be going, then?

296.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_001
296.description: You could always stay awhile longer, you know! There's no need to rush─we could chat! Please? Everyone else is so busy and Hodge is no fun at all! ...<hex:021A020203>Please<hex:021A020103>?

297.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_000
297.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts, our quality of life here in Sharlayan Hamlet has been drastically improved.

298.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_001
298.description: Wouldn't you agree, Hodge? I'm sure <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has also spared you a modicum of grief.

299.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_004_002
299.description: ...If you wish to spare me grief, you might refrain from causing it in the first place.

300.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_003
300.description: Oh, that Hodge. He plays coy, but there's no denying that you have done much and more to ease Thesauros's burdens.

301.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_004
301.description: Mark my words: if we keep peddling your services, one day Hodge will leap over his desk and wring your hand in tearful gratitude! Or perhaps just offer a genuine word of thanks!

302.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_000
302.description: Hodge! Have I mentioned in the past bell just how much <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has single-handedly improved the state of Labyrinthos with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> contributions?

303.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_001
303.description: Roaring Spring and Ibuki and Grondilvet and all their teams─and a great number of other researchers besides─have showered <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> with a veritable deluge of praise.

304.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_002
304.description: Now it's your turn! One word, just one <hex:021A020203>tiny<hex:021A020103> little word of appreciation on behalf of Thesauros! Let's hear it!

305.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_005_003
305.description: ...I process requests. I do not issue public statements.

306.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_004
306.description: ...It may not seem like it, but we're making progress! We'll coax a heartfelt expression of gratitude from him yet!

307.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_005
307.description: Trust me, I've been bothering Hodge for years now; he's like an old, musty tome I've read cover to cover a dozen times. I see all the subtleties between the lines. So let's keep up the good work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

309.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_001
309.description: According to Theopauldin, we've seen significantly increased returns from each and every laboratory here in Labyrinthos.

310.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_002
310.description: An external assessment might conclude that the projects we began in the wake of the Final Days have simply begun to yield results. That our labors were bound to bear fruit eventually. But we all know better.

311.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_003
311.description: We know that our increased productivity─not to mention sunny morale─is largely thanks to you, my industrious friend.

312.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_004
312.description: Which means that Hodge is now <hex:021A020203>obligated<hex:021A020103> to say something nice, if only out of basic decency!

313.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_005
313.description: ...The gratitude I must express is threefold.

314.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_006
314.description: First, for the safe return of you and your fellow Scions to the star.

315.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_007
315.description: Second, for the procurement of resources that Thesauros has been reluctant to provide. And third, for your social and moral support of the researchers here.

316.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_008
316.description: ...It warms my heart to see them happy.

317.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_009
317.description: Hodge, you─! H-How dare you force me to weep tears of gratitude in your s-stead, you sneak! You c-crafty gil-pincher! You emotional capitalist! <sob>

318.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
318.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Margrat. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

319.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_MARGRAT_000_000
319.description: Who's next to storm the gates, I wonder?

320.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_002
320.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Margrat as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
